beliefs.belief: He is still the man I knew, and that is the difficulty.
He said yes with a condition that was right, and let me ask for it myself. He's learned something since Betazed.
Said he'd let me raise it and then asked for me himself. Still, he asked for the right reason.

recent: the link between them, felt on the bridge
heard Data report the internal sensors never logged Q
La Forge saw Q through the VISOR: even heat, no pulse
asked Lloyd, through the link, for a word off duty tonight
Q's clothes read the same temperature as his skin, to the VISOR
Hesker IV: children among the dead
Lloyd asked through the link what was wrong; she told him only that she felt something on the bridge, not hers to tell; asked to go down to Hesker IV for the families
Lloyd: she's on the away team once Crusher knows how it spreads; raise it at the briefing and he'll back her
1300 briefing: Crusher's summary of the Hesker IV reports
Lloyd asked for her on the ground with the herders; she had meant to ask herself
